results.title: Disassembled Sony α7 III undergoing water damage repairs.jpg
results.desc: My Sony α7 III , disassembled at a camera repair shop in Shenzhen whilst undergoing repairs, following water damage from heavy rain in Hong Kong during the day prior. Never trust Sony and their marketing department when they say that their camera products are weather sealed, they're completely full of shit, as my personal experience demonstrates. The majority of the corrosion occurred on the section of the PCB closest to the battery compartment. Anyway, I highly recommend this guy, he did a great job of cleaning up the corrosion all over the PCB and the ribbon cable contacts, and managed to get my camera fully functional again within a few hours. If you just happen to be in the Shenzhen area and require similar repairs, look for 深圳市一諾數碼科技技術服務中心 located at 深圳市福田區華強北路新華強電子世界三樓Q3B213. I'd recommend getting in around 11:00AM if you want a quick turnaround, because by the afternoon the locals seem to start trickling in for repairs, but for some reason not a single person came in the morning.
